BEGIN;

-- 004/005 are historical migrations and intentionally remain unchanged.
-- This upgrade keeps existing student runtime data while aligning the schema
-- with the practice-task catalog contract.
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.student_practice_task') IS NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.student_pet_project') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_pet_project RENAME TO student_practice_task;
    END IF;

    IF to_regclass('public.student_practice_task_milestone') IS NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.student_pet_project_milestone') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_pet_project_milestone RENAME TO student_practice_task_milestone;
    END IF;

    IF to_regclass('public.student_practice_task_artifact') IS NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.student_pet_project_artifact') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_pet_project_artifact RENAME TO student_practice_task_artifact;
    END IF;

    IF to_regclass('public.student_practice_task_task_binding') IS NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.student_pet_project_task_binding') IS NOT NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE student_pet_project_task_binding RENAME TO student_practice_task_task_binding;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
DECLARE
    item record;
BEGIN
    FOR item IN
        SELECT *
        FROM (VALUES
            ('student_practice_task', 'pet_project_id', 'practice_task_id'),
            ('student_practice_task_milestone', 'student_pet_project_id', 'student_practice_task_id'),
            ('student_practice_task_milestone', 'pet_project_part_milestone_id', 'practice_task_part_milestone_id'),
            ('student_practice_task_artifact', 'student_pet_project_id', 'student_practice_task_id'),
            ('student_practice_task_task_binding', 'student_pet_project_id', 'student_practice_task_id'),
            ('student_practice_task_task_binding', 'student_pet_project_milestone_id', 'student_practice_task_milestone_id')
        ) AS renames(table_name, old_column, new_column)
    LOOP
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_schema = 'public'
              AND table_name = item.table_name
              AND column_name = item.old_column
        ) AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM information_schema.columns
            WHERE table_schema = 'public'
              AND table_name = item.table_name
              AND column_name = item.new_column
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE format(
                'ALTER TABLE %I RENAME COLUMN %I TO %I',
                item.table_name,
                item.old_column,
                item.new_column
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

-- PostgreSQL does not rename dependent index and constraint names when a
-- table/column is renamed. Rename them as well so no active schema identifier
-- still exposes the old catalog terminology.
DO $$
DECLARE
    item record;
BEGIN
    FOR item IN
        SELECT index_class.relname AS old_name,
               replace(
                   replace(index_class.relname, 'student_pet_project', 'student_practice_task'),
                   'pet_project',
                   'practice_task'
               ) AS new_name
        FROM pg_class AS index_class
        JOIN pg_index AS index_meta ON index_meta.indexrelid = index_class.oid
        JOIN pg_class AS table_class ON table_class.oid = index_meta.indrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace AS namespace ON namespace.oid = table_class.relnamespace
        WHERE namespace.nspname = 'public'
          AND table_class.relname IN (
              'student_practice_task',
              'student_practice_task_milestone',
              'student_practice_task_artifact',
              'student_practice_task_task_binding'
          )
          AND index_class.relname LIKE '%student_pet_project%'
    LOOP
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_class AS target
            JOIN pg_namespace AS target_namespace ON target_namespace.oid = target.relnamespace
            WHERE target_namespace.nspname = 'public'
              AND target.relname = item.new_name
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE format('ALTER INDEX %I RENAME TO %I', item.old_name, item.new_name);
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

DO $$
DECLARE
    item record;
BEGIN
    FOR item IN
        SELECT constraint_class.conname AS old_name,
               replace(
                   replace(constraint_class.conname, 'student_pet_project', 'student_practice_task'),
                   'pet_project',
                   'practice_task'
               ) AS new_name,
               table_class.relname AS table_name
        FROM pg_constraint AS constraint_class
        JOIN pg_class AS table_class ON table_class.oid = constraint_class.conrelid
        JOIN pg_namespace AS namespace ON namespace.oid = table_class.relnamespace
        WHERE namespace.nspname = 'public'
          AND table_class.relname IN (
              'student_practice_task',
              'student_practice_task_milestone',
              'student_practice_task_artifact',
              'student_practice_task_task_binding'
          )
          AND constraint_class.conname LIKE '%student_pet_project%'
    LOOP
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM pg_constraint AS target
            WHERE target.conrelid = item.table_name::regclass
              AND target.conname = item.new_name
        ) THEN
            EXECUTE format(
                'ALTER TABLE %I RENAME CONSTRAINT %I TO %I',
                item.table_name,
                item.old_name,
                item.new_name
            );
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

COMMIT;
